interview.question: Supply eight separate decisions at the original evidence time. E01.01: identify approved governance objectives, initiative grouping and reviewed Policy-as-code rollout/maintenance; an initiative count or literal effect is not strategy or enforcement. E01.03: bind applicable regulatory obligations, customer/Microsoft/shared responsibilities and exact Policy/RBAC controls using attributable redacted evidence; built-in regulatory groupings, including current Preview status, are not a legal-compliance verdict. E01.04: explicitly designate the intermediate root below the actual tenant root and prove complete intended assignment ancestry; no name or missing parent establishes either root. Global built-ins are distinct from custom management-group/subscription definitions. E01.05: decide the highest appropriate scope for each control and justified lower-scope exclusions versus tracked exemptions; review conditions, mode, versions, overrides, resource/identity selectors, expiry and evaluation/remediation evidence separately. E01.06: provide the organization-approved services and exceptions and show the applicable audit/restriction controls; no generic allowed-service taxonomy is assumed. E01.07: compare actual built-in scope/cloud/version/parameter/effect suitability with custom alternatives and maintenance cost; a global GUID reference is not fetched content, existence or suitability. E01.08: identify the application team and least-privilege scope, actual active membership/PIM, conditions/deny assignments and remediation-identity grants; Resource Policy Contributor36243c78-bf99-498c-9df9-86d9f8d28608 includes control-plane read, PolicyInsights, deployments/support, not role-assignment write or dataActions. Workload RBAC is normally subscription/resource-group scoped; no reference/principal-type/count proves effective delegation. E01.09: explicitly establish tenant-root identity and review only must-have root assignments, exclusions and debugging/maintenance complexity against complete attributable inventory; no numeric assignment cap is prescribed and a selected tree is not complete. Use redacted supporting references, not rule bodies, principal records, service-list contents or fabricated organizational/legal decisions.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Minimized explicit definition type/mode/literal effect and initiative member references; unique known in-scope custom definition joins require exact matching supplied versions and positive placement ancestry. No recursive evaluation or implicit fetch.
evidence_requirements: Reviewer decision: Are the approved governance objectives represented by appropriate initiative groups, reviewed changes, staged audit/enforcement and a maintained operating strategy?
recommendations.limitations: Literal effect and grouped references are configuration, not evaluated conditions, valid parameter/effect combinations, complete coverage, remediation or organizational strategy.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Bounded initiative group counts and hashed member labels, definition/assignment references and existing minimized role context prepare independent Policy/RBAC mapping review without retaining any regulatory mapping.
evidence_requirements: Reviewer decision: Which obligations and customer/Microsoft/shared responsibilities apply, and what exact attributable Policy/RBAC mapping and independent supporting controls satisfy them?
recommendations.limitations: Current regulatory grouping guidance calls the feature Preview. Mapping, assignment, member count and saved compliance Signals prove neither legal compliance nor effective RBAC.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Exact custom management-group/subscription definition locations and supplied positive hierarchy paths distinguish valid local placement from unbound ancestry; global built-in references stay global, unfetched and unjoined.
evidence_requirements: Reviewer decision: Is the explicitly designated intermediate root directly below the actual tenant root, and does each custom definition location cover every intended assignment through attributable complete ancestry?
recommendations.limitations: Names, absence of visible parents, a selected MG tree or definition references establish no tenant/intermediate-root designation, complete hierarchy or effective inherited result. Resource-group custom definitions are unsupported locations.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Exact assignment-ID scope, explicit exclusions with positive descendant checks, version-bound custom definition context, separate enforcement/selector/override counts and separately qualified saved exemption references.
evidence_requirements: Reviewer decision: Is this the highest appropriate assignment scope, with justified lower exclusions versus tracked time/member/selector-bound exemptions, complete intended coverage and actual effect/evaluation/remediation evidence?
recommendations.limitations: Default enforcementMode, nonempty assignment inventory or ancestor linkage cannot prove enforcement. DoNotEnforce still permits evaluation. Missing arrays remain unknown, not empty; selector/override bodies and conditions are never interpreted.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Explicit supported mode/literal effect and scoped assignment/definition references prepare audit/restriction review, withholding all service-list/parameter/rule contents.
evidence_requirements: Reviewer decision: What services and exceptions has the organization approved, and which applicable controls actually audit/restrict provisioning across the authorized scope?
recommendations.limitations: No universal approved-service taxonomy exists in AM-2. A deny/audit literal does not identify a service allowlist, enforce it or authorize a new ARG query/scan.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Definition policyType and reference namespace distinguish explicit custom configuration from globally identified built-in references; unsupported/missing/versioned/wildcard bindings remain unknown rather than fetching or treating a GUID as content.
evidence_requirements: Reviewer decision: Are actual original-time built-ins suitable for the required cloud/scope/mode/version/parameters/effects, and is any custom alternative justified against maintenance overhead?
recommendations.limitations: A global built-in reference is not a custom intermediate-root definition, a fetched version, evidence of existence/effect or suitability. Provider metadata does not synthesize an exact effective version.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Reuse existing unique known scoped role assignment principal-type and typed role-definition reference; recognize the exact Resource Policy Contributor GUID without retaining personal principals or interpreting permissions.
evidence_requirements: Reviewer decision: Is the intended application team actively and appropriately delegated at the least-privilege subscription/resource-group scope, considering PIM/membership, conditions/deny assignments, broad control-plane read and separate remediation-identity grants?
recommendations.limitations: Role reference is not actual team identity, active effective authority, proper scope or roleAssignments/write. No new assignment/grant, identity read or permission interpreter is added.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Supplied-subset scoped assignment/exclusion counts, unresolved/truncated populations and positive saved MG parent edges prepare root-complexity review without automatically naming the tenant root.
evidence_requirements: Reviewer decision: After explicitly establishing tenant-root identity and complete inventory, are only justified must-have assignments placed there, with manageable inherited exclusions/exemptions and debugging/maintenance complexity?
recommendations.limitations: The guidance supplies no numeric root-assignment cap. Missing parent does not establish tenant root, zero supplied assignments does not establish absence, and selected inventory cannot establish organizational appropriateness.
